subject: Information and Communication Technology
examFormat: Two papers taken as a composite paper at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice objective questions, all to be answered in 45 minutes for 20 marks. Paper 2: four compulsory test-of-practical-knowledge questions and six essay-type questions; candidates answer the compulsory practical questions and any two of the others in 2 hours for 80 marks.

topics.name: Introduction to Basic ICT Concepts and Computers
objectives: Explain the meaning of ICT and its related terminologies
Describe the uses of ICT tools such as mobile phones, computers, the Internet, television set and radio
Discuss the impact of ICT on education, social and economic development
Describe the information processing cycle and distinguish between data and information
Identify the types and uses of computers

topics.name: Computer Hardware
objectives: Identify the categories of computer hardware: system unit, peripherals and storage media

topics.name: Computer Software
objectives: Distinguish between system and application software
Distinguish between open source and proprietary software

topics.name: Threats to Computers and Users
objectives: Explain the meaning of computer threats
Identify the categories of computer threats: natural threats (e.g. earthquakes, heat, floods) and human threats (e.g. viruses, worms, intentional damage)
Explain the causes and effects of health hazards to computer users
Describe remedies to threats and hazards

topics.name: Word Processing
objectives: Describe word processing packages, their uses and importance
Explain related concepts and terminologies
Create and save documents
Edit, format and insert objects such as tables and graphics
Print documents
Type with speed and accuracy at 30-35 words per minute

topics.name: Spreadsheet
objectives: Describe spreadsheet packages, their uses and importance
Explain related concepts and terminologies
Identify the types of data and their uses
Create and save a workbook
Construct and insert formulae and functions
Edit and format worksheets
Print worksheets

topics.name: Presentation
objectives: Describe presentation packages, their uses and importance
Create and save presentations
Edit, format and insert objects
Run slide shows
Use master slides
State the factors to consider before delivering a presentation
Print presentation documents

topics.name: The Internet
objectives: Explain the meaning, concepts, terminologies and requirements of the Internet
Describe the features and uses of browser windows
State the rules and regulations in the use of the Internet (netiquette)
Send and access e-mail
Use Internet-related communication tools, e.g. chatting, downloading, uploading, search engines and social media
